summary: Phase 7C-2 staff composer for Owner Updates (HorseProfile 'Updates' tab) fully verified end-to-end. All 8 scenarios in the review request passed with zero console/page errors. Role gating works (admin sees tab; owner & groom do not). Composer creates draft -> non-sensitive publish -> archive (soft, row remains) AND sensitive draft -> submit-for-review (awaiting review, read-only). Edit/submit/publish controls only show on draft rows; pending_review and archived rows are read-only. Sensitive hint copy is exact. No 7C-3 review controls (approve/request-changes/review-note) leaked into this tab.
critical_code_review_comments: HorseOwnerUpdates.jsx is well-scoped (~245 lines), single responsibility, uses data-testid throughout. No refactor needed for 7C-2 scope.

Minor: api.delete/cleanup for created owner_updates is not exposed in this tab; that's acceptable since 7C-2 is author-only. Cleanup leftover demo rows (see ids below) only if barn QA hygiene matters.

Minor (non-blocking): act() handles error.response.data.detail but create()/saveEdit() use generic toast text — they would miss a server-provided 409 message (e.g. attempting to publish a sensitive draft). Not reachable from this UI since publish button is hidden for sensitive drafts, but worth noting for defense in depth.
